description: The line plot illustrates the performance of four datasets—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval—across different numbers of training samples generated by language models. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Samples Generated," shows four distinct values: K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64. The y-axis, labeled "Micro F1 (%)", ranges from 20 to 50, indicating the performance metric. TACRED and TACRED-Revisit lines are closely aligned, with TACRED-Revisit consistently outperforming TACRED by about 5% across all sample sizes. Re-TACRED shows a steady increase, peaking at 51% at K=64, while SemEval demonstrates a slower rate of improvement, reaching 47% at K=64. Each dataset is represented by a unique line style and marker, as indicated in the legend located in the top left corner of the plot.

TACRED and TACRED-Revisit exhibit similar trends, with TACRED-Revisit consistently outperforming TACRED by approximately 5% across all sample sizes. Re-TACRED demonstrates a steady increase, peaking at 51% at K=64, while SemEval shows a slower rate of improvement, reaching 47% at K=64. The legend in the top left corner maps each dataset to its corresponding line style and marker.
